'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Siege of Gaza City]]
***The [[Israel Defense Forces]] orders a complete [[emergency evacuation|evacuation]] of all [[Palestinians]] from [[Gaza City]] to areas south of the city in advance of a new [[offensive (military)|offensive]] against [[Hamas]]. [https://apnews.com/article/israel-palestinians-hamas-war-news-07-10-2024-6358a61735f0e30132decce781860594 (AP)]
**[[United States support for Israel in the Gaza war]]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]]'s [[Presidency of Joe Biden|administration]] resumes shipments of [[Mark 82 bomb|500-pound bombs]] to [[Israel]] following a suspension in May 2024 due to worries of harm to [[Palestinians|Palestinian]] civilians. The initial suspension provoked public criticism from [[Prime Minister of Israel|Israeli PM]] [[Benjamin Netanyahu]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/us-resume-shipping-500-pound-bombs-israel-us-official-says-2024-07-10/ (Reuters)]
*[[Insurgency in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]]
**Four security officials and three [[Pakistani Taliban]] [[insurgent]]s are killed in a [[shootout]] in [[Peshawar]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/pakistan-raid-militant-hideout-peshawar-110263355bc7e6aadf700447f05da412 (AP)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**Two [[Ukrainians]] are killed by [[Russia]]n [[Drone warfare|drone]] and missile attacks on a port in southern [[Odesa Oblast]], [[Ukraine]], which damaged port infrastructure, an energy facility, and a [[civilian]] ship. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-attack-ukraines-odesa-region-kills-two-damages-port-ukraine-says-2024-07-10/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[National Samsung Electronics Union]] announces that around 30,000 [[Samsung Electronics]] workers will now [[industrial action|strike]] indefinitely after accusing the company of refusing to hold talks on better pay. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c51yelv4e72o (BBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Thirteen people, including 12 children, are killed in a [[school bus]] [[traffic collision|crash]] in [[Merafong City Local Municipality|Merafong]], [[Gauteng]], [[South Africa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-schoolchildren-killed-car-crash-8d64d0c23447e5063870eba4e7ca597b (AP)]
*A [[Aerial firefighting|plane]] fighting the Horse Gulch fire [[plane crash|crashes]] into [[Hauser Dam#Hauser Lake|Hauser Lake]] in [[Montana]], [[United States]], killing the pilot onboard. [https://www.montanarightnow.com/helena/pilot-dies-in-plane-crash-while-fighting-horse-gulch-fire/article_b38eff62-3efe-11ef-ae65-fb710f4c42a7.html (KWYB)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 Washington summit]]
**[[Foreign relations of China]], [[China and the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
***All 32 [[NATO]] member states approve an [[NATO Washington Summit Declaration|official statement]] classifying [[China]] as a "decisive enabler" of [[Russian invasion of Ukraine|Russia's invasion of Ukraine]] due to its "no-limits" economic and political partnership with [[Russia]]. [https://apnews.com/article/nato-china-pacific-washington-59876b88cad3ccf15cc5443912fe3d5b (AP)]
*[[Russia–Saudi Arabia relations]], [[International sanctions during the Russo-Ukrainian war]]
**[[Bloomberg News|Bloomberg]] reports that [[Saudi Arabia]] warned the [[G7]] earlier this year that it would sell off [[Eurobond (eurozone)|Eurobonds]] and [[France|French]] bonds if the G7 proceeded with the seizure of US$280 billion in [[Russia|Russian]] [[Asset freezing|frozen assets]] to give to [[Ukraine]]. [https://kyivindependent.com/saudi-arabia-warned-g7-against-seizing-russian-assets-bloomberg-reports/ (''The Kyiv Independent'')]

**A criminal court in [[Baghdad]], [[Iraq]], [[sentence (law)|sentences]] the widow of [[Islamic State]] [[caliph]] [[Abu Bakr al-Baghdadi]] to death over her ties to the Islamic State and for detaining [[Yazidi]] women in her house. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/07/10/iraq-court-sentences-widow-of-isis-s-al-baghdadi-to-death (Al Arabiya)]
*[[Hunt family murders]]
**Louise's ex-boyfriend Kyle Clifford, wanted for the [[crossbow]] attack in [[Bushey, Hertfordshire]], [[United Kingdom]], is arrested in [[Enfield, London]]. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/news/world/2024/07/10/john-hunt-kyle-clifford-bbc-crossbow-manhunt/74350957007/ (''USA Today'')]
*Two [[Australians|Australian]] [[tourism in the Philippines|tourists]] and a [[Filipinos|Filipino]] woman are killed during a [[mass stabbing]] at a hotel in [[Tagaytay]], [[Philippines]]. [https://apnews.com/article/philippines-tagaytay-australians-killed-hotel-b52126eda4ea6e9eb39a7bcbe0321314 (AP)]
